<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Austrian Representation Office (BMEIA)"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Landlord" name="Landlord and Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ContactRepresentation" name="Request information" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Participant_Representation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AccommodationRequest" name="Accommodation negotiation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Participant_Landlord"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AccommodationReply" name="Accommodation offer" sourceRef="Participant_Landlord" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BankNegotiation" name="Bank account negotiation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBank" targetRef="Participant_Landlord"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisaApplication" name="Visa application" messageRef="Msg_VisaApplication" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision" messageRef="Msg_VisaDecision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_DecisionReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria - Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance for further information"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NegoSplit" name="Start negotiations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBank" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NegoJoin" name="Negotiations completed"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaLoopMerge" name="Start visa determination"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Visa type"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OfficeSchengen" name="Identify representation of main travel destination (Schengen visa)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OfficeCategoryAC" name="Identify representation in consular district of legal residence (category A or C)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OfficeTypeD" name="Identify competent Austrian representation by place of residence (type D)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfficeMerge" name="Competent representation determined"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocSplit" name="Prepare visa documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Form" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDoc" name="Provide valid travel document (issued within last ten years, validity beyond stay plus three months, at least two empty pages)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Photo" name="Provide passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Insurance" name="Provide comprehensive travel health insurance (EUR 30,000, valid in Schengen area, for entire stay)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Subsistence" name="Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence (stay and return journey)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Evidence" name="Provide other evidence requested by authorities"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocJoin" name="Documents prepared"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" name="Additional documents requested?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditional" name="Provide additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalMerge" name="Documents complete"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DecisionReceived" name="Visa decision received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Decision" messageRef="Msg_VisaDecision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Visa granted?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Refused" name="Visa refused"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RenewalTimer" name="Wait for next visa period (every x months)">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_Renewal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RenewalCheck" name="Visa renewal required?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRenewal" name="No further visa required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_NegoSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_NegoSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_NegoSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBank"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_NegoJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBank" targetRef="Gateway_NegoJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_NegoJoin" targetRef="Gateway_VisaLoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaLoopMerge" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Schengen visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_OfficeSchengen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_OfficeCategoryAC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_OfficeTypeD"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_OfficeSchengen" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_OfficeCategoryAC" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_OfficeTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DocSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_DocSplit" targetRef="Task_Form"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_DocSplit" targetRef="Task_TravelDoc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_DocSplit" targetRef="Task_Photo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_DocSplit" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_DocSplit" targetRef="Task_Subsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_DocSplit" targetRef="Task_Evidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_Form" targetRef="Gateway_DocJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_TravelDoc" targetRef="Gateway_DocJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_Photo" targetRef="Gateway_DocJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_Subsistence" targetRef="Gateway_DocJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_Evidence" targetRef="Gateway_DocJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Gateway_DocJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditional" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalMerge" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Event_DecisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Event_DecisionReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="End_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Event_RenewalTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Event_RenewalTimer" targetRef="Gateway_RenewalCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RenewalCheck" targetRef="Gateway_VisaLoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RenewalCheck" targetRef="End_NoRenewal"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
